faqs.a:
It is unlawful for any person, without obtaining all appropriate permits, to connect
               to or use any sanitary or storm sewer for the purpose of dumping sewage, including
               but not limited to contents of grease separators and septic tank holdings. The charge
               for unauthorized use of the sewer will be a special charge equal to the charge which
               would have been applicable had the use of the sewer been authorized, in addition to
               a base charge of $100.00 for each unauthorized use.
(Code 1981, § 33-66; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
